title: 箱涵頂進施工
summary: 本課以箱涵頂進的力鏈、地層損失與營運界面為主線，從箱涵自重與滑移界面與油壓推力與後座反力建立系統邊界，再把刃口接觸與局部承壓、姿態修正與曲線相容連到封鎖窗口與恢復證據。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on box-jacking load paths, ground loss and operating interfaces. It begins with Box weight and sliding interfaces and Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force, links Cutting-edge contact and local bearing and Attitude correction and path compatibility, and ends with Possession windows and restoration evidence. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「箱涵自重與滑移界面」與「油壓推力與後座反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Box weight and sliding interfaces" and "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「箱涵自重與滑移界面」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Box weight and sliding interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。自重決定底面接觸的部分法向力，浮力和地層反力則會改變分布；把外包體積全部視為實心會高估重量並扭曲推力預估。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區；若出現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「箱涵自重與滑移界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. Weight contributes to base normal force, modified by buoyancy and soil reactions. Treating the bounding volume as solid overstates mass and distorts thrust estimates. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Box weight and sliding interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Box weight and sliding interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面
knowledge.text: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。自重決定底面接觸的部分法向力，浮力和地層反力則會改變分布；把外包體積全部視為實心會高估重量並扭曲推力預估。
knowledge.textEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. Weight contributes to base normal force, modified by buoyancy and soil reactions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「箱涵頂進施工」的「箱涵自重與滑移界面：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Box weight and sliding interfaces: mechanism and system paths” in “Box-jacking construction”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「箱涵自重與滑移界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Box weight and sliding interfaces" is correct?
options: 箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積
箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
optionsEn: Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume
Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water.
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
quiz.explanation: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Box weight and sliding interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Box weight and sliding interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
optionsEn: A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「箱涵自重與滑移界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Box weight and sliding interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「箱涵自重與滑移界面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Box weight and sliding interfaces"?
options: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比
optionsEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage
quiz.explanation: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Box weight and sliding interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區；若出現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「油壓推力與後座反力」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。油封摩擦、回油壓及不同缸位使表壓總和不是精確合力；推力能力與後座可承力是不同限制，不能因油壓未滿就判斷可繼續增加負載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫；若出現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「油壓推力與後座反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. Seal friction, return pressure and cylinder states affect the result. Hydraulic capability and reaction-wall capacity are separate constraints; unused pressure capacity does not establish permission to increase load. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「油壓推力與後座反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. Seal friction, return pressure and cylinder states affect the result.

knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

optionsEn: Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage
Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：定量估算

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「油壓推力與後座反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
